# Feature requirements per OS

What each feature of `_shared/modules/features/manifest.toml` needs outside
the driver itself, per OS. The declarations are the `requires` field of each
feature; `tools/test/test-feature-requirements.cjs` derives the same table from
the drivers (the macOS Karabiner generator state fields and remap facade
callers, and the source signatures of `requirements.toml`) and fails when the
two disagree in either direction.

`—` means nothing external; `n/a` means the feature is not on that OS (its
`platforms` and `reason_key` say why).

## Vocabulary

| Requirement | Kind        | OS                    | What it is                                                                                                                |
| ----------- | ----------- | --------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `karabiner` | application | macos                 | Karabiner-Elements (shared mode) or Ergopti's owned Karabiner runtime, with its VirtualHIDDevice driver                   |
| `evdev`     | kernel      | linux                 | Read access to `/dev/input/event*` (the input group), for the exclusive keyboard grab and the touchpad                    |
| `uinput`    | kernel      | linux                 | Write access to `/dev/uinput` (the udev rule of `install/setup_permissions.sh`), the output channel of every injected key |
| `xdotool`   | program     | linux                 | xdotool, X11 only: pointer, window and screen queries and actions                                                         |
| `wmctrl`    | program     | linux                 | wmctrl, X11 only: workspace switching                                                                                     |
| `zenity`    | program     | linux                 | zenity, or kdialog on KDE: the confirmation dialogs a feature shows itself                                                |
| `ollama`    | runtime     | macos, linux, windows | The Ollama inference server that runs the local models                                                                    |
| `mlx`       | runtime     | macos                 | The MLX (mlx-lm) Python environment Ergopti creates for on-device inference on Apple silicon                              |
| `webview2`  | runtime     | windows               | The Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime, which renders the windows a feature shows itself                                     |
